entities.name: Yonnhy Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yonnhy Pérez is a Colombian former professional boxer who competed from 2005 to 2011. He held the IBF bantamweight title from 2009 to 2010, reaching a peak ranking of number three at bantamweight by The Ring magazine in December 2010.
